name: atstarter-control
description: Control the local atstarter desktop app through MCP and JSON CLI commands.

interface.shortDescription: Start projects, groups, Docker, compose, and logs through atstarter.
interface.longDescription: Provides a local MCP server and usage guidance for controlling the atstarter desktop project launcher. The desktop app remains the runtime source of truth; the plugin calls the app through its localhost control service.
defaultPrompt: Scan my workspace and add detected atstarter projects.
Create an atstarter launch group for my local stack.
Switch this project between compose and command mode.
